title: Encode, index, and search a tiny sparse corpus
prompt: Encode and index a tiny corpus using a supplied trained nonnegative projection, then search query codes. Return sparse codes, postings, rankings, and total nonzeros. Gallery IDs are row indices. This is the checkpoint-to-index/inference core; optimization and relevance evaluation use earlier exercises.
